  (A : H →L[ℂ] H),
  ((1 - S.starProjection).comp A).comp S.starProjection = 0 →

HArithmeticTrace.full_arithmetic_compression_extension.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) :
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let S := JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  Sᗮ.subtypeL.comp ((Sᗮ.orthogonalProjection.comp (A.comp Sᗮ.subtypeL)).comp Sᗮ.orthogonalProjection) =
    (1 - S.starProjection).comp A
